title: Create draft election
evidence: E21 (2026-10-27 live-DB): every governance verb refuses a non-draft election, so the draft is the only configurable state; NominationAcceptVetCertify refuses to open an election with one certified candidate, RollBuildFreezeChallengeRevokesMidPoll refuses to open before the roll is frozen, and CancellationSealsTheBallot/InformalPollIsNonBinding walk draft→open→close through the service.
notes: Open is its own governance act with load-bearing preconditions (≥2 candidates on the ballot, a frozen roll where a roll has been assembled, voting cannot start before nominations close). BFF gap recorded as ESTB-D015: POST /api/v1/elections still writes status='open' directly, so the mobile create path bypasses the workflow.

title: Election rule approval
evidence: E21 RuleApprovalAppliesAndLocks: a proposal is draft-only, one pending proposal per election (partial unique index), approve writes the in-force election_eligibility_rules row with approved_by/at and stamps rules_locked_at, reject leaves the in-force rules untouched, and a locked election refuses re-proposal.
notes: Rules are now proposed→approved(and locked) by a second actor;the in-force row stays in place so pre-migration elections behave identically

title: Build electoral roll
evidence: E21 RollBuildFreezeChallengeRevokesMidPoll + UnfrozenRollDoesNotGate: BuildElectionRoll snapshots the eligible residents into a new versioned draft roll with an eligible_count, re-buildable only while the election is draft; FreezeElectionRoll publishes it and it becomes the ballot's source of truth (estate_cast_vote refuses a voter absent from the latest frozen roll). A roll that has never been frozen constrains nothing, so elections configured before this migration are unaffected.
notes: Roll entity with versioning + freeze;entries carry per-holder ballot weight

title: Multiple-unit owner eligibility
evidence: E21 PerUnitWeighting: a one_vote_per_unit election requires the unit that authorises the ballot, refuses a voter who does not hold it (landlord or tenant on a non-archived property), and lets the same voter cast one ballot per held unit — UNIQUE(election_id,unit_id) WHERE unit_id IS NOT NULL; a one_person_one_vote election refuses any unit. CountQuorumWithWeighting proves a holder's ballots count as their weight. E22 covers the BFF/mobile half: /ballot reads participation as a LIST (a maybeSingle() there answered every weighted voter's receipt screen with an error), the mobile ballot keys choices by position:unit, and the receipt names the holding each vote belongs to.
notes: Secrecy preserved: election_votes stores no choice (since 20271099000010) so adding unit_id links a voter to a unit, never to a selection

title: Electoral roll challenge
evidence: E21 RollBuildFreezeChallengeRevokesMidPoll: a member challenges another member's entry with a reason (≥5 chars, enforced in the schema), the challenge is listed to admins only, and ResolveRollChallenge(uphold) removes the subject's roll entry and stamps removed_by/at; rejecting it leaves the entry active. Upholding a challenge therefore changes who may vote, without touching a single ballot.
notes: Challenge workflow on the frozen roll;uphold = removal

title: Candidate nomination
evidence: E21 NominationAcceptVetCertify: any estate member may nominate a member (self-nomination allowed) with a seat and a statement inside the configured nomination window; UNIQUE(election_id,nominee_user_id) means one nomination per person; the certified nomination is the only way onto election_candidates, and the ballot line is named from the platform directory rather than invented by the proposer.
notes: Nomination flow replaces candidates-at-create for governed elections

title: Invalid nomination
evidence: E21 NominationAcceptVetCertify: refused and not recorded — a non-member cannot be nominated and a non-member cannot nominate; a duplicate nomination for the same person is refused; outside a configured window the ballot is closed to new names; the decision verb is an enum (anything but accept/decline/withdraw is refused) and an unknown nomination id is refused; a declined name can neither be re-nominated nor un-declined.
notes: Rejections are audited (decided_by/at + reason) rather than silent

title: Candidate acceptance
evidence: E21 NominationAcceptVetCertify: only the nominee may accept (a proposer accepting on their own behalf is refused); certifying before acceptance is refused; certifying before vetting is refused; an admin flag (vet cleared=false) blocks the ballot until cleared=true; only accepted+cleared reaches election_candidates, a second certify of the same nomination is refused, and withdrawal is final. A member sees certified lines and their own nominations, never another member's workflow state.
notes: Accept + vet + certify are three separate gates;the nominee alone can accept

title: Cast valid secret ballot
evidence: E17 (2026-10-27 live-DB, after the ballot split): TestLiveDB_Vote_ConcurrentDuplicateVote_ResultsInOneBallot proves one row per voter under two genuinely concurrent CastVote calls; TestLiveDB_Vote_BallotCannotBeJoinedToVoter proves the persisted participation row holds candidate_id IS NULL, the receipt returned by CastVote is the election_ballots id (not the participation id), the voter→choice rejoin (election_votes JOIN election_ballots ON election_id AND candidate_id) returns 0 rows, and the tally credits the choice exactly once. Log docs/qa/estate-uat-443/live-2026-10-26/livedb-estate-suite-phase2.1.log. Migration 20271099000010_estate_election_secret_ballot.sql applied as E18.
notes: One ballot per voter, counted once, receipt is the anonymous ballot id; the schema no longer links voter→choice (ESTB-D003 closed by the split).

title: Voting receipt anonymity

BFF half unchanged: vote/route.ts writes through estate_cast_vote and /ballot selects id+cast_at only. Log docs/qa/estate-uat-443/live-2026-10-26/livedb-estate-suite-phase2.1.log.

title: Revoke vote eligibility mid-poll

Revocation is immediate and takes no effect on ballots already cast, which stay anonymous.
notes: Frozen roll is the source of the right to vote;rules alone are the pre-roll gate

title: Abstain/blank ballot

E22 pins the BFF half (vote/route.ts forwards candidateId=null instead of requiring a candidate) and the read paths (mapElection/admin tally count abstentions in turnout only). UI: the mobile ballot screen now offers an explicit Abstain line per position (app/election/index.tsx), and the receipt counts that position as voted while naming no candidate.

title: Election quorum/turnout
evidence: E21 QuorumBlocksCertification + CountQuorumWithWeighting: quorum is configured on the draft (none | percent | count, percent against the frozen roll's weighted size, count against ballots cast); TallyElection refuses to certify below quorum and the outcome reports `quorum_met` with turnout denominators (eligible, ballots, abstentions). A count quorum under per-unit weighting counts ballots, not voters, which is what a household vote needs.
notes: Quorum is a certification gate rather than a display number

title: Tie-break rule
evidence: E21 TieBreak (3 subtests on the same tied ballot): tie_break='none' returns verdict=tie with every leader listed and certifies nothing; 'earliest_candidate' resolves to the first-certified line and the verdict records the rule that decided it; 'runoff' returns verdict=runoff_required so certification waits for a second poll instead of inventing a winner.
notes: The rule is configured before opening and applied by the tally, never by the client

title: Publish certified results
notes: Publish is now a certification act delegated to the governance service (quorum met, tie resolved by the configured rule, no open complaint/recount outstanding) instead of a local status write; the BFF refuses to publish a draft or a cancelled election and fails closed if the governance call cannot be reached. E21 covers the gates, E22 pins the route-level delegation.

title: Election complaint or recount
evidence: E21 ComplaintGatesCertificationAndRecount: a member files a complaint or a recount request with detail (≥5 chars); an open complaint blocks TallyElection from certifying until an admin upholds or dismisses it with a resolution; running a recount re-reads the aggregate totals from election_ballots (never per-voter) and records ballots_cast/abstentions plus the linked complaint.
notes: Recount snapshots are aggregate-only so a recount cannot re-link a voter to a choice

title: Election audit export
notes: Aggregates are now complete and still contain no per-voter choice: audit reads ballots_cast from election_ballots against distinct_voters from election_votes (deliberately different tables, so a missing counterpart is visible), turnout/outcome/recount surfaces expose quorum, verdict and per-candidate totals only. Still missing: a downloadable export — recorded as deferred to the Phase 5 reporting cluster rather than claimed here.

title: Election cancellation
evidence: E21 CancellationSealsTheBallot: cancel needs a reason (≥5 chars, enforced by a CHECK as well as in Go), stamps who and when, refuses a second cancel and refuses to cancel a certified result (a complaint is the route for that), and the next ballot is refused in the write path itself (estate_cast_vote raises 42501 'election has been cancelled'). Cast ballots are kept anonymous rather than deleted, so cancellation does not destroy participation evidence.
notes: Cancellation is an audited terminal state;not a row delete

title: Informal estate poll
evidence: E21 InformalPollIsNonBinding: kind='poll' runs the identical ballot, roll and quorum machinery but its certified outcome carries binding=false (Outcome.Binding is derived from kind), and the governance console exposes kind as a per-election choice.
notes: One ballot engine with two declared weights of outcome
